$comment: External measured facts for the hypothetical full-elimination example. In a real scenario, these would come from published experimental data: an in vivo study measuring excision outcomes per cell in the target tissue.

facts.note: Hypothetical: measured elimination of viral reservoir in human liver organoids. In reality, no gene therapy has achieved this with sufficient evidence to pass this floor.

data.note: Hypothetical distribution. 80% deletion + 4% degradation = 84% success per copy. These numbers are fabricated for demonstration.
